newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Colombia plans coffee campaign in China - minister.
newsitem.headline: Colombia plans coffee campaign in China - minister.

text.p: Colombia aims this year for a big push to convince China's tea-drinking millions to switch to coffee, according to Foreign Minister Maria Emma Mejia.
"This year we intend to try China," Mejia told Reuters during a visit to Brussels. "The potential is enormous."
Mejia, in Brussels for trade talks with European Commission officials, said Colombia would be opening its first coffee shop in Beijing later this year.
"Our first store will be at the main station, the biggest in the world, and we hope to give a profile to our coffee," Mejia said.
Mejia, who visited Beijing last year as part of an official trade delegation, said Colombia aimed to tap into the Chinese market in a similar way to tactics tried in Japan in the last decade.
"Japan wasn't such a big market 10 years ago but look at it now," she said. "We have got a good profile there and we hope to do the same in China."
